project_type: Python signal-only trading bot for NAS100
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt 2. Run pytest tests/ 3. Run python -m nas100bot.main --dry-run to verify bot starts without errors
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt && cp config.example.yaml config.yaml
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.9 system default, pyenv has 3.10-3.14. yfinance, pandas, numpy already installed. Need to install python-telegram-bot, schedule, pyyaml, ta (technical analysis).
key_patterns: Greenfield - establishing patterns: modular Python package (nas100bot/), YAML config, signal-only architecture (never auto-execute trades), Kelly criterion math, confluence scoring
directory_structure: Root: /projects/sandbox/hii. Structure to create: nas100bot/ (main package with modules for data, edges, signals, kelly, telegram, scheduler), tests/ (pytest tests), config.example.yaml, requirements.txt, README.md
